<content>
1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
8:   // audio setup
9:   const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
10:   const audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
11:   let bgOsc = null;
12:   function startBackground(){
13:     if (bgOsc) return;
14:     bgOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     bgOsc.frequency.value = 30;
17:     bgOsc.type = 'sine';
18:     bgOsc.connect(gain);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
21:     bgOsc.start();
22:   }
23:   function playBeep(freq, dur){
24:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
25:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
26:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
27:     osc.type = 'square';
28:     osc.connect(gain);
29:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
30:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
31:     osc.start();
32:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
33:   }
34: 
35:   // Ship
36:   const ship = {w:40, h:20, x:W/2, y:H-30, speed:6};
37:   const keys = {left:false, right:false};
38: 
39:   // Asteroids
40:   const asteroids = [];
41:   let asteroidTimer = 0;
42:   const asteroidInterval = 90; // frames
43:   const stars = [];
44:   const STAR_COUNT = 80;
45:   for(let i=0;i<STAR_COUNT;i++){
46:     stars.push({x:Math.random()*W, y:Math.random()*H, r:Math.random()*1.5+0.5});
47:   }
48:   let level = 0;
49:   let score = 0;
50:   let startTime = null;
51:   let gameOver = false;
52: 
53:   function spawnAsteroid(){
54:     const size = 20 + Math.random()*30;
55:     const angle = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
56:     const rotSpeed = (Math.random()-0.5)*0.04; // radians per frame
57:     asteroids.push({x:Math.random()*(W-size), y:-size, w:size, h:size, speed:2+level*0.3, angle, rotSpeed});
58:     // sound for new asteroid
59:     playBeep(200, 0.05);
60:   }
61: 
62:   function update(){
63:     if (gameOver) return;
64:     // ship movement
65:     if (keys.left) ship.x -= ship.speed;
66:     if (keys.right) ship.x += ship.speed;
67:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W-ship.w, ship.x));
68: 
69:     // asteroids
70:     asteroidTimer++;
71:     if (asteroidTimer >= asteroidInterval){
72:       asteroidTimer = 0;
73:       spawnAsteroid();
74:     }
75:     asteroids.forEach(a=>a.y+=a.speed);
76:     // remove off‑screen
77:     for(let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
78:       if (asteroids[i].y>H) asteroids.splice(i,1);
79:     }
80:     // collision
81:     for(const a of asteroids){
82:       if (a.x < ship.x+ship.w && a.x+a.w > ship.x && a.y < ship.y+ship.h && a.y+a.h > ship.y){
83:         gameOver = true;
84:         // collision sound
85:         playBeep(100, 0.4);
86:         break;
87:       }
88:     }
89:     // score & difficulty
90:     const elapsed = (Date.now()-startTime)/1000;
91:     score = Math.floor(elapsed);
92:     level = Math.floor(elapsed/10);
93:   }
94: 
95: function draw(){
96:     // background
97:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
98:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
99:     // stars
100:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
101:     stars.forEach(s=>{
102:       ctx.beginPath();
103:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
104:       ctx.fill();
105:     });
106:     // ship
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
108:     ctx.beginPath();
109:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
110:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
111:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
112:     ctx.closePath();
113:     ctx.fill();
114:     // asteroids (rotating polygons)
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a44';
116:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{
117:       ctx.save();
118:       ctx.translate(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2);
119:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
120:       ctx.beginPath();
121:       ctx.moveTo(-a.w/2, -a.h/2);
122:       ctx.lineTo(a.w/2, -a.h/2);
123:       ctx.lineTo(a.w/2, a.h/2);
124:       ctx.lineTo(-a.w/2, a.h/2);
125:       ctx.closePath();
126:       ctx.fill();
127:       ctx.restore();
128:       // update rotation for next frame
129:       a.angle += a.rotSpeed;
130:     });
131:     // score
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
133:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
134:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+score, 10, 20);
135:     if (gameOver){
136:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
137:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
138:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
139:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
140:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
141:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W/2, H/2);
142:       ctx.textAlign = 'start';
143:     }
144:   }
145:   }
146: 
147:   function loop(){
148:     update();
149:     draw();
150:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
151:   }
152: 
153:   // input
154:   document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')keys.left=true; if(e.key==='ArrowRight')keys.right=true; startBackground();});
155:   document.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')keys.left=false; if(e.key==='ArrowRight')keys.right=false;});
156:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); ship.x = e.clientX - rect.left - ship.w/2;});
157: 
158:   // start
159:   startTime = Date.now();
160:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
161: })();

(End of file - total 161 lines)
</content>
